oracle exits rc=1 "NO FILENAME ON COMMAND LINE" with no argv. A general-purpose SIL-to-C translator tool (genc family) that reads its OWN source path from argv via HOST(2,HOST(3)); no fixture argv is shipped for it. Even if one were supplied, its output embeds DATE() (`OUTPUT = '/* generated from ' SILPATH ' by genc.sno on ' DATE ' */'`), so no run could ever be byte-reproducible against a stored ref.

oracle exits rc=0 with EMPTY output when run exactly as tests.in registers it (`SNOBOL_PRELOAD_PATH=pa:pb preload3.sno`). "pa"/"pb" are not vendored anywhere in this corpus (unlike aa/, bb/, which ARE — see preload1.sno/preload2.sno in UNGRADED.tsv), so the preload path resolves to nothing. Empty output is a plausible correct answer for a path that resolves to nothing, but not one this census will mint a ref for absent a real pa/pb fixture (this suite's own precedent: never mint a vacuous empty ref, ALL.excluded.txt).
